text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: observed retry amplification + intermittent TLS resets during the 03/20 cross-region surge. This thread is tracking owners, timelines, and next steps.

maria: Short root cause hypothesis: LB route sticky behavior + aggressive probe settings caused upstream path thrashing. Thrashed backend sockets then hit an older kernel TLS path that drops some handshakes -> transient 5xx surge.

maria: High-level action items (owners / ETA):
- alex: revert route-priority tuning and run a 15% canary (ETA: 2026-03-26)
- jin: align probes to stable endpoint, add 20s interval + jitter, and implement probe handshake validation (ETA: 2026-03-24)
- sam: create alert & dashboard for retry amplification patterns (>150 retries/s per region for 60s) and add recording rules (ETA: 2026-03-25)
- shreya: update postmortem runbook with precise rollback and verification steps; include openssl + pcap checks (ETA: 2026-03-27)
- kyle / infra: validate upstream kernel TLS patches on fl-edge-canary and report perf/regressions (ETA: 2026-04-03)

maria: I uploaded pcap + logs to the incident bucket: https://storage.redwood.com/incidents/2797770000/artifacts. Grep keys: `TLS alert` and `retry_count=2` sequences.

alex: taking the LB rollback. Plan: snapshot -> canary 15% -> monitor retry metric -> roll if clean. Commands:
`rbctl snapshot lb lb-edge-12`
`rbctl route set-priority --lb lb-edge-12 --policy legacy`
`rbctl canary --lb lb-edge-12 --pct 15 --dur 30m`

alex: will start the canary 2026-03-26T08:00Z unless jin asks us to wait for probe changes.

jin: i'll take probe tuning. Current probe: 5s/2/1. I'll change to: interval=20s, unhealthy=3, healthy=2, jitter=10s, path=/health/ready-handshake. Also add a handshake check that validates TLS can complete. Snippet: ```yaml
healthcheck:
  path: /health/ready-handshake
  interval_seconds: 20
  healthy_threshold: 2
  unhealthy_threshold: 3
  jitter_seconds: 10
  tls_check: true
```

jin: applying in staging today and will post results.

sam: on alerts. Proposed PromQL: `sum(rate(lb_retry_total[1m])) by(region) > 150` -> fire if persists for 2 mins. I'll also add a per-route 95th percentile retry histogram. Ticket: NET-891.

sam: need affected route list to scope dashboards. alex, can you paste after snapshot?

alex: snapshot done. Affected primary routes: `route-721a`, `route-721b`, `route-919`. Those showed the strongest amplification.

shreya: drafting runbook updates: runbook will include: how to isolate region, how to flip LB priority, how to run `openssl s_client` checks, and how to collect pcap + kernel TLS traces. PR will link to artifacts.

kyle: infra note: older edge boxes (build tag edge-2021.6) have kernel TLS fallback that may trigger under high SYN+reset churn. We'll validate kernel patch fixes on canary fleet. ops-bot, schedule please.

ops-bot: Kernel patch validation scheduled for fl-edge-canary on 2026-03-30. Assigned: infra-sre.

alex: canary started at 2026-03-26T08:00Z. Initial 30m window: retry spikes dropped ~35% in eu-central; no latency spike. Posting summary in NET-891.

jin: staging probe results: handshake-validated healthcheck stabilized 4/5 runs. One failure correlated with a backend process OOM that reset sockets. Not purely LB problem. Adding backend accept-path 1s backoff to test race condition.

sam: created NET-891 dashboard and linked it: https://tracker.redwood.com/NET-891. Alert rule and recording rules pushed to staging Prometheus.

shreya: runbook PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/pull/2026. Includes step-by-step rollback and verification. Please review.

alex: after canary we see fewer retries, but route-919 still shows occasional bursts. We should be conservative before global roll.

jin: will run backend accept-path delay test tonight in staging against route-919 to reproduce. If it reduces resets, we'll prioritize fixing the backend accept/retry handling.

kyle: infra will run kernel TLS patch on fl-edge-canary next week and capture handshake histograms. ETA report 2026-04-03.

sam: monitoring note: added synthetic probe that mimics client retry headers to ensure amplification doesn't mask real client behavior.

maria: decision: prioritize server-side (LB + probe + kernel patch) first. Client retry throttles are last resort and require product coordination.

alex: logged subtask NET-891#1 for canary rollback. Marked in-progress.

jin: test result: backend accept 1s backoff reduced TLS resets in staging for 3/3 runs. Will open backend ticket APP-432 to change accept behavior and add graceful socket close handling.

shreya: merged runbook PR, added a checklist: collect pcap -> run `openssl s_client` -> check `tls_handshake_failures` metric -> rollback LB priority if >5% handshake errors in 5m.

ops-bot: Canary `lb-edge-12` canary job completed: 15% for 30m. Outcome: reduced retry counts, no perf regression.

alex: recommending staged global rollout next week after jin's probe/back-end fixes and kyle's kernel validation.

kyle: infra will also check for noisy NIC drivers on older boxes; adding driver update validation to canary.

maria: final asks: each owner add a 1-2 line status in NET-891 by 2026-03-28. We'll meet 2026-04-01 for closure review. If still open, extend owners/timelines.

sam: ack, will keep monitoring dashboards during the staged rollout.

jin: ack, opening APP-432 and posting results.

alex: ack and standing by for prod rollout window.

kyle: ack, will share kernel validation report when ready.

deploy-bot: incident 2797770000 actions moved to NET board. Automation: retention artifacts archived.

maria: thanks team. Closing thread; will re-open on regressions. :thumbsup:
